brief: 7 tools that turn one engineer into a team. Names, urls, why each matters.

slots.title: 1. GitHub, the collaborator
slots.body: Actions run CI, Issues track bugs, and Copilot reviews code so you ship without a dev team.

slots.title: 2. Vercel, the platform
slots.body: Preview deployments, edge functions, and analytics replace a frontend platform engineer on every push.

slots.title: 3. Notion, the brain
slots.body: Docs, roadmaps, and wikis in one hub eliminate the need for a dedicated PM or writer.

slots.title: 4. Linear, the planner
slots.body: Cycles, prioritization, and GitHub sync automate sprint planning so you never need a scrum master.

slots.title: 5. Stripe, the billing
slots.body: Stripe handles invoicing, tax, and global payments out of the box, removing finance and ops overhead.

slots.title: 6. Figma, the designer
slots.body: Design, prototype, and handoff in the browser replaces a UI designer and keeps assets developer-ready.

slots.headline: Deploy Your Solo Stack
slots.subline: Grab this stack and ship products faster than most funded teams.
